meta.rl_answer: hosting.com has the lower sale price ($1.49 a month on 12 months) and the shorter commitment. Hostinger has the lower renewal price ($10.99 against $13.99 a month). Pick by how long you plan to stay.

meta.rl_takeaways:
hosting.com is the new name of A2 Hosting.
hosting.com has the lower sale price and the shorter commitment.
Hostinger has the lower renewal price.
The two were tested by different publishers, so the numbers do not line up.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is hosting.com the same as A2 Hosting? | Yes. A2 Hosting announced on its own blog in April 2025 that it is now hosting.com.
Is hosting.com cheaper than Hostinger? | For the first term, yes: hosting.com Starter is $1.49 a month on a 12-month plan, and Hostinger Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month plan. At renewal, Hostinger is lower.
Which has the lower renewal price? | Hostinger Premium renews at $10.99 a month. hosting.com Starter renews at $13.99 a month, as each host lists on its own page.
Do both hosts list AI features? | Yes. Both list an AI website builder, an AI assistant and an MCP server. We have not tested them.
Do both offer a money-back guarantee? | Both list a 30-day money-back guarantee on their pages.
Which host should I pick for a new WordPress site? | Pick the one that fits how long you plan to stay. hosting.com suits a short first term, and Hostinger suits a long one.
